scope: Synthetic local execution and immutable-archive validation only; no Android/device run, no network, no repository commit
checks: Strict source/workflow-mode, job, attempt, commit, artifact identity and job-time binding
Missing and expired artifacts preserve two unverified arms and unobserved restoration
Comparison denominator and two raw-arm denominators remain separate
Failed enabled arm, failed setting restoration and unavailable input observation are archived without promotion
Incomplete baseline preserves unexecuted enabled arm and no setting mutation
Source verification uses actual temporary-repository byte hashes; host validators are not mocked in integration tests
Each raw arm source catalog is bound to parent catalog; changed source bytes are rejected
Missing or altered fixture APK, altered AVD config, forged original-setting journal, rehashed wrong restoration output, rehashed foreign raw marker and inconsistent IME sidecar are rejected
Only baseline/enabled nesting is allowed; symlinks, deep paths, nonregular files and malformed JSON are rejected
Per-file limits, original 16MiB per-arm bounds and shared 36MiB tree bound are preserved
Existing archive paths are never overwritten

readOnlyReview.scope: Archive provenance, bounds, original bytes, missing/expired status and comparison/arm/restoration separation

limitations: Synthetic responses are not real APK or keyboard acceptance.
The controller and workflow require their own integration and dedicated-emulator validation.
